newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia coffee czar keeps eye on Africa, Asia.
newsitem.headline: Colombia coffee czar keeps eye on Africa, Asia.

text.p: Colombian coffee producers must become more efficient in order to meet a future challenge from coffee-producing nations in Asia and Africa, Colombia's coffee czar said Thursday.
"Colombia cannot afford to turn its back on Asia and Africa which are entering the competition," Jorge Cardenas, head of the National Coffee Growers' Federation, told an agricultural forum in Bogota.
"Significant volumes will come out of Africa and Asia and the great challenge facing Colombia is to produce competitively priced, good quality coffee," he added.
